Hi Bishen,

I saw your post for the UI/UX Designer role, and I am drawn to the focus on attention to detail for empty states, error messages, and loading screens.

At AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and translated findings into improved user flows and interface usability. I also built reusable design systems at Ascent Business Solutions to cut turnaround time.

My B2B case study Bounceless shows a cleaner verification experience for teams depending on accurate email lists, which you can see at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I would love to discuss how I can help turn briefs into working designs for your team. I am based in Nagpur and ready to relocate if required.

Ananya
